source: 3例药物相互作用引起的药物不良反应分析_刘晓.pdf
text:
抖动; 1 例为螺内酯与地高辛联用，导致地高辛中毒; 1 例为华法林与莫西沙星、阿奇霉素联用，导致血尿。 结论在评估患者病情确实需要联合用药对患者进行治疗时，应同时分析是否存在不良的药物相互作用，权衡利弊，为患者制定更加合理的药物治疗方案。
刘晓，孔妍，崔一民，梁雁( 北京大学第一医院药剂科，北京 100034)LIU Xiao，KONG Yan，CUI Yi － min，LIANG Yan( Department of Pharmacy，Peking University First Hospital， Beijing 100034， China)Abstract: Objective To analyze 3 cases of adverse drug reactions caused by drug interactions. Methods We selected the adverse drug reactions induced by drug interactions from the summary of 1003 cases of adverse drug reactions reported in our hospital during 2010 － 2014，and analyzed and evaluated the cases one by one. Results There were 3 cases of the adverse drug reactions due to drug interactions in the all 1003 cases of adverse drug reactions. One case was a patient given voriconazole combined with cyclosporine leading to the cyclosporine plasma concentration increased and the patient was limb － shaking. One case was a patient given spironolactone combined with digoxin leading to digoxin poisoning; One case was a patient given warfarin combined moxifloxacin and azithromycin causing hematuria. Conclusion In the assessment of the patients who really need combination therapy，the doctor should also analyze the existence of adverse drug interactions and weigh the pros and cons to make more reasonable drug regimens for the patients.药物间的相互作用可影响药物代谢，进而导致药物原有药理作用的叠加、降低，还可引起药物不良反应( ADR) 的增加或降低。 合理的药物相互作用可以增加药物的有效性，减少 ADR 的发生; 反之，不合理的药物相互作用则可以降低药物的有效性，增加 ADR 的发生。住院患者中，每日用药 1 ～ 5 种、6 ～ 10 种、11 ～ 15 种的潜在药物相互作用发生率分别为 12. 1% ，29. 0% ，44. 8% ，实际 ADR 发生率分别为3. 5%，10. 0%，28. 0%［1］。 每年因药物相互作用的致死率，占住院患者致死原因的第 4 ～ 6 位。 因此，合理地联合应用药物，避免不良的药物相互作用是联合用药中不容忽视的问题。 本文通过汇总整理我院2010 ～ 2014 年上报的 1003 例 ADR，从中筛选出 3 例因药物相互作用引起的 ADR，对其进行分析和再评价，为临床避免不合理的药物联合应用提供参考。
